name: HomeSafeBench
description: HomeSafeBench is a benchmark for embodied vision-language models in free-exploration home safety inspection tasks. It provides 12,900 data points with dynamic first-person perspective images from simulated home environments, enabling evaluation of VLMs' ability to identify common home safety hazards through free exploration.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark that is still emerging and has limited community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on five common home safety hazards; allows free exploration with multiple dynamic perspectives; current VLMs perform poorly with best F1-score of 10.23%.
